From: Mike Torres <mike.torres@novabank.com>

Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:00 +0000

Thanks Emily / Marissa.

Procurement checklist/questions from our side: 
- Vendor registration: we prefer vendors to register via our Vendor Portal (https://vendors.novabank.com/register). If you can't access the portal we can accept the vendor form via email but it adds an extra manual step.
- Required docs: completed vendor form, W-9 (US tax), Certificate of Insurance (COI) — please confirm COI is available.
- Payment terms: NovaBank is net-30 by default; if Redwood needs anything different note it here.
- Invoice format: PDF invoices that include PO number (when issued) and remit-to info below. Please confirm you can send invoices to ap-invoices@novabank.com.
- PO timeline: once we receive completed vendor registration + COI + W-9 we typically issue a PO within 7-10 business days (barring legal review).
- Tax / vendor legal: Legal will do a short review of our standard MSA; expect that to be 3-5 business days unless redlines are significant.

Remit / Billing address:
NovaBank Inc.
Accounts Payable
100 Finance Ave.
Boston, MA 02110

If you can pre-populate the vendor portal fields and upload the docs today (or tomorrow), we can aim to have a PO to you by 2027-06-08.

-Mike
Mike Torres
Vendor Management | NovaBank
